entities.name: Anaïs Michel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anaïs Michel is a French weightlifter, competing in the 48 kg category and representing France at international competitions. She competed at world championships, most recently at the 2015 World Weightlifting Championships. She also competed at the 2017 European Weightlifting Championships.
